_about: Owner-editable wording and the mapping from each area of life to the KP rule it follows. The favourable and unfavourable HOUSES are NOT set here: they are read from the KP rule table (antar_engine/kp/kp_significators.QUESTION_TYPES, the book rules) so there is one source. star_weight/sub_weight: the star lord decides what the day is about, the sub lord whether it goes through (KP). No planet or house names in the plain text.

money.label: money
money.up: money coming in, or a payment moving
money.down: money going out, or a payment held up

work.label: work
work.up: a visible win or recognition at work

relationship.label: relationships
relationship.up: a warm or useful conversation with someone close

health.label: health
health.down: low energy or something to watch in your body

travel.label: travel
travel.up: a trip, or news from far away
travel.down: delays or disruption when moving around

home.label: home
home.up: something settling at home or with property
home.down: friction at home, or a property matter stalling

quiet: Nothing stands out today: the lords of the day touch no area strongly.
